short_summary: This document outlines the needs assessment for a project in Norfolk, focusing on older populations and physical activity. It includes policy frameworks from health care, social care, physical activity, and environment sectors. The main objectives are to assess current access to physical activity and the natural environment for older people and to identify gaps that need to be addressed.
